# Farmer's Cutting：Regions Unexplored
為 [Regions Unexplored](https://modrinth.com/mod/regions-unexplored) 新增更多 [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) 砧板食譜

- 所有（適用）木材的樹皮切割、剝除與回收
- 從產出染料的花草中獲得更多染料

![Wood Cutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lFKDc2ny/images/2a53f76caadbdcf397c8729fbee6140e8e95f43f.png) ![Flower Cutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lFKDc2ny/images/c4edfd171292676ade621e94f6d1fcbf1d87a8cc.png)
